uuid, name, sort_num, is_login, is_permission, type, app_id, h5_url, icon, description, is_deactivated, is_personal, category, sub_category, create_time, update_time, sub_name,

mapper.delete:
delete from service_config where id in

mapper.select:
select sc.* from service_config sc left join wx_user_menu_new wmn on sc.id = wmn.menu_id and wmn.phone = #{phone} where sc.is_deactivated = 0 and ( sc.category != '政府服务' OR (sc.category = '政府服务' AND wmn.phone IS NOT NULL) OR (sc.category = '政府服务' AND sc.is_permission = 1) )
and sc.description like concat('%', #{description} ,'%')
order by sc.sort_num desc, sc.create_time desc

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT b.* FROM wx_user_menu_new a LEFT JOIN service_config b ON a.menu_id = b.id AND b.category = '政府服务' and b.is_deactivated = 0 WHERE a.phone = #{phone} AND b.id is not null UNION ALL SELECT * from service_config WHERE category = '政府服务' and is_permission = 1 ) T ORDER BY T.sort_num DESC

select A.*, B.phone from service_config A left join ( select distinct phone, menu_id from wx_user_menu_new where phone = #{phone} ) B on A.id = B.menu_id where A.is_deactivated = 0 AND category = '政府服务' ORDER BY A.sort_num
where is_deactivated = 0 and category in ('市民服务','推荐关注') order by sort_num desc, create_time desc
select count(*) from service_config where uuid = #{uuid}
